stories.title: Aberdeen appoint Liechtenstein's Frick as head coach
stories.summary: Former Liechtenstein striker Mario Frick is announced as the new head coach of Aberdeen.

stories.title: Why 'inspiring' Van Gaal influences Scotland head coach Pocognoli
stories.summary: Scotland head coach Sebastien Pocognoli says he draws on the influence of iconic manager Louis van Gaal in his own coaching career.

stories.title: Final whistle a blessing as Scotland edge dull Test against Australia
stories.summary: Scotland edge a dull Nations Championship encounter against Australia at Murrayfield.

stories.title: Trident submarine returns home after record-breaking undersea patrol
stories.summary: Defence Secretary Wes Streeting was at HM Naval Base Clyde to welcome the crew after the longest deployment at sea for a British vessel.

stories.title: Police watchdog issues workload warning as high-level case load soars
stories.summary: Laura Paton, the Police Investigations and Review Commissioner, said the record level of demand was jeopardising her ability to help deliver justice on behalf of communities.

stories.title: Supermarket badly damaged as thieves rip cash machine from wall
stories.summary: Part of the Co-op's wall has collapsed in Doune, leaving the inside completely exposed and the pavement strewn with debris.

stories.title: Eleven officers convicted of crimes still on police payroll, chief confirms
stories.summary: Police Scotland Chief Constable Jo Farrell said there were other cases with "incontrovertible evidence" against officers, but they cannot be sacked quickly enough.

stories.title: Schoolboy imposter subjected ex-professor and wife to 'terrifying ordeal'
stories.summary: Brian MacKinnon - who posed as a school boy in his 30s - targeted a former university professor as he lay in bed with his wife.

stories.title: Police probe unexplained death of four-month-old baby
stories.summary: The death occurred inside a property in Milton and was reported to the force on Wednesday.

stories.title: Shetland's first paramedic to retire after 38 years of island-hopping call outs
stories.summary: Ambulances were driven by hospital porters and gardeners without medical training before Niall Bristow joined the service.

stories.title: Thousands turn out in Edinburgh to protest against AI data centres
stories.summary: Demonstrators armed with placards - and some dressed in costume - assembled at the top of the Royal Mile before marching towards the Scottish Parliament.

stories.title: I never thought I'd make it as an actor but now I'm up for a Bafta
stories.summary: Scott Ellis Watson, 16, portrayed John Davidson's teenage experience with Tourette's in the hit film I Swear.
